text:
Friction-wheels. The surfaces of these wheels are made rough, so as to bite as much as possible; one is sometimes faced with leather, or, better, with vulcanized india-rubber.

— Henry T. Brown, Five Hundred and Seven Mechanical Movements (1908), no. 32
provenance: Henry T. Brown, Five Hundred and Seven Mechanical Movements, 21st edition (1908), movement 32; public-domain excerpt. Transcription: https://507movements.com/mm_032.html.
